long_biography.plain_text:
Edem became Oleksandr Guzenko's principal industrial platform, developing from a small wallpaper factory into a Ukrainian producer of foamed-vinyl wall coverings. The business combined design and manufacturing, launched domestic production under the Versailles and Status brands, and built export markets across Europe, the Middle East and neighbouring states.

Natural gas forms another industrial platform for Guzenko. In 2020 he and his daughter Tetyana acquired Nadra-GeoInvest, each taking half of the company. The business conducts exploration, drilling and production of natural gas, giving him a substantial second industrial interest beyond construction materials. Company reports identify him as a direct beneficial owner, while the enterprise's published activities show a full-cycle upstream operation.

uncertainties.detail: The exact English full name has little public coverage. The identity is resolved through the former Julia relationship, specialist yacht-to-Edem connection, exact Ukrainian patronymic, Dnipro geography and official company disclosures. Other people with the Guzenko surname and same-name Ukrainian register entries without this combined business and yacht context were rejected.

Nadra-GeoInvest is a demonstrably material current gas-producing asset in which Guzenko directly owns 50%. Edem remains defining to his origin story, but its current ownership and financial scale were not established from comparably strong recent records. Energy therefore reflects the strongest positive current evidence, not a complete ranking of all personal assets.

Broad Self-made rests on positive reporting that Guzenko moved Edem from importing to domestic manufacture. His seed capital and family platform are unknown, preventing a starting-position subtype. Direct Nadra-GeoInvest ownership is public, but day-to-day management is not; Passive asset owner avoids inferring an operating mandate.

No reliable full birth date, birthplace, secondary nationality or identity-secure personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website met the threshold. No personal social link is proposed.

Exact-name and transliteration searches, including site:forbes.com/profile and Edem or Nadra-GeoInvest combinations, found no dedicated profile. Forbes Council results for Ivan and Serge Guzenko concern different people.

Construction materials captures the defining Edem platform, while Oil & gas exploration and production captures the separately material current Nadra-GeoInvest stake. Hotel operations was omitted because SunRay is one secondary project and the reviewed evidence does not establish it as a principal wealth source. No new tag candidate was created.

The short biography is a 50-word identity and wealth-origin card. The long profile uses Edem only as a shared anchor and adds its manufacturing specialism, brands, export development and the documented family acquisition of Nadra-GeoInvest. Both exclude yachts, current rankings, volatile wealth figures and private addresses.
